articles.summary: Herc Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HRI), one of North America’s leading equipment rental suppliers operating through Herc Rentals Inc. (“Herc Holdings,” “Herc Rentals” or the “Company”), today announced that President Aaron Birnbaum and Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Mark Humphrey will participate in the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference in Chicago on November 10, 2026. A fireside chat discussion and simultaneous webcast will take place that day at 9:05 a.m. CT (10:05 a.m. ET). A live webcast of the fireside chat will be available at: Herc Holdings Inc. The webcast will also be archived on the events and presentation page on the Company’s investor relations site: https://ir.hercrentals.com/events-and-presentations . About Herc Holdings Inc. Founded in 1965, Herc Holdings Inc., which operates through its Herc Rentals Inc. subsidiary, is a full-line rental supplier with 615 locations across North America and 2025 total revenues of approximately $4.4 billion. The release will be followed by an investor conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET.
